candidate.name: intraday_amount_schedule_uniformity_240m
candidate.mechanism: L1 distance of the complete cumulative CNY amount-share clock distribution from the fixed discrete uniform schedule
candidate.formula: For finite nonnegative a_i on i=0..239 and S=sum a_i>0, set p_i=a_i/S, F_k=sum_{i=0}^k p_i and U_k=(k+1)/240 for k=0..238; return 1-sum_k abs(F_k-U_k)/119.5.
candidate.normalization: 119.5 is the exact maximum L1 cumulative distance on the 240-position simplex, attained when all mass is at either endpoint.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_amount_participation_entropy_240m and intraday_amount_lorenz_gini_240m
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Both existing distribution summaries are invariant to arbitrary clock permutations. Campaign262 generally changes when the same 240 amount masses are permuted because the cumulative schedule changes. Equal inequality or entropy does not determine cumulative distance to uniform clock time.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_amount_center_of_mass_240m, intraday_amount_clock_dispersion_240m and intraday_amount_clock_third_central_moment_240m
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Those retain only the first three amount-weighted clock moments. Campaign262 integrates absolute discrepancy of the entire cumulative distribution; distinct finite profiles can share the first three moments while having different cumulative L1 distance.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: late_amount_share_30m, intraday_terminal_bar_amount_share_240m and intraday_opening_auction_amount_share_241m
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Fixed-window factors use one cutoff or the standalone 09:30 row. Campaign262 excludes 09:30, has no chosen subwindow and uses every one of the 239 cumulative boundaries.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_amount_profile_serial_persistence_240m, intraday_amount_path_efficiency_238p, intraday_amount_local_peak_density_238p and intraday_amount_weak_order_entropy_236t
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Local path definitions depend on adjacent cardinal or ordinal changes. Campaign262 depends only on integrated prefix masses: local permutations can change peaks, serial persistence or weak-order states while preserving a constructed cumulative-distance total, and global mass relocation can change Campaign262 without changing the amount multiset.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_top_decile_amount_event_spacing_entropy_25g and intraday_peak_amount_bar_recency_240m
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Event factors discard most magnitudes after selecting one or 24 extrema. Campaign262 retains all 240 amount masses and has no rank threshold or event tie rule.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_morning_afternoon_amount_profile_similarity_120b, intraday_day_over_day_amount_profile_similarity_240b and intraday_market_amount_profile_synchronization_240m
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Those compare two empirical profiles. Campaign262 has one stock-day profile and one deterministic uniform reference, so it is invariant to every other stock and session.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_relative_amount_share_clock_center_240m and intraday_session_total_amount_magnitude_240m
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: The relative clock center requires cross-sectional relative shares and total magnitude changes under common scaling. Campaign262 uses only own-stock shares and is exactly invariant to common positive amount scaling.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: candidate49_intraday_cumulative_vwap_crossing_rate_240m_v1
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Candidate49 is a future-only causal price/amount anchor-crossing ledger. Campaign262 reads no price, creates no crossing and never writes or backfills a prospective ledger.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: rejected Campaign262 variants
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: No reversal count, L2 or supremum distance, half-session reset, learned U-shape, clock quantile, alternate direction, threshold, filter, subset, fit, model or combination is admitted.

independence_witnesses: Any nontrivial clock permutation preserves Campaign261 Lorenz-Gini exactly but can change Campaign262.

A uniform positive 240-bar profile scores 1; concentrating all mass at either endpoint scores 0; concentrating all mass near the middle has the same maximal Gini as an endpoint but a different Campaign262 score.
Profiles can share their first three clock moments yet differ in higher-order cumulative shape and therefore in Campaign262.

decision.required_next_step: Bind the concept hash, then freeze one exact no-return protocol, pure formula, feature builder and synthetic tests before any Campaign262 local source value is read.
